title: RangeIterator
prompt: Create a class RangeIter(start, stop, step) that is iterable and yields start, start+step, ... below stop. Implement __iter__ and __next__ (return self from __iter__).

tests.name: yields the right values
tests.hint: Stop when the next value would be >= stop.

tests.name: empty range
tests.hint: start >= stop means nothing to yield.
